time_window_24h_4h.conclusion: Simple time-window expansion is not a useful official optimization.

reverse_batch_order.conclusion: Simple forward/reverse order selection is insufficient.

partial_subsequence.conclusion: Robust partial matching is a secondary, modest-yield branch.

excluded_long_legs_10plus.conclusion: Simply restoring excluded long legs is not effective.

physical_tracklet_bridge.conclusion: Simple two-tracklet stitching has very low direct Stage5 yield.

tail_date_unique_fallback.conclusion: Unique same-tail/date fallback does not rescue current failures.

tail_date_multiflight_fallback.conclusion: Naive multi-flight fallback without sequence modeling is ineffective.

primary_diagnosis: The dominant limitation is real spatial/trajectory mismatch, not candidate count.
Stage3 pseudo validation is much easier than real AMDAR matching and is not domain-matched.
Stage5 uses independent nearest-segment projection plus hard monotonic rejection rather than probabilistic sequence alignment.
Stage2 v7 rescored inherited v4 legs but did not rebuild the raw ADS-B track segmentation.
Simple Stage5-only heuristics do not support a path from 198 to 566 accepted batches.
